statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))/2 ≤ (15/8 : ℝ)*r a b+K

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 全局高度与 abc · JA-0066 · 在 ℓ=7 取得独立于三元组的 Frey 高度上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Global heights and abc · JA-0066 · Obtain a Frey height bound at ℓ=7 uniformly over triples

brief.zh: 该开放界等价于指数 15/8 的具体弱 abc 界，并经 JA-0064 蕴含 JA-0059。常数必须统一于全部互素正整数对。
brief.en: This open bound is equivalent to the fixed exponent 15/8 and implies JA-0059 via JA-0064. Use one constant for all coprime positive pairs.
